newsitem.title: CHINA: China central bank may tweak loan rates-newspaper.
newsitem.headline: China central bank may tweak loan rates-newspaper.

text.p: China's central bank is very unlikely to reduce bank deposit interest rates again in the foreseeable future, but may realign some loan interest rates, the official Business News reported on Wednesday.

The Shanghai-based newspaper quoted a senior official from Huaxia Securities, one of the biggest brokerages in China, as saying the central bank was expected to continue its tight credit policies due to the risk of a rebound in inflation.

"Given that inflationary pressure has not been eliminated, a further reduction in deposit interest rates is unlikely, but in terms of loan interest rates, the central bank may make some structural adjustments," the official said.
The official, who was not named, said the central bank was moving increasingly towards using indirect means to influence money supply and interest rate movements.
